params.idea: idea I5 of docs/research/idea_survey_v4.md: idle cash earns a broker sweep rate instead of zero
params.instrument: synthetic QLD* daily-reset 2x on QQQ total return, expense 0.95%/yr, financing DTB3 + {base 0.0, calibrated 0.75%/yr}
params.reason: ADOPT Z2: highest pre-tax base m = 2 CAGR among the candidates clearing every gate
params.signals: production K (equity_leveraged_trend_v1 1.2.0): E2 2-of-3 on price closes (SMA200, 252-session price return > 0, close > 126-session max/min midpoint) + early re-entry at 0.5 x vt while E2 off and close > SMA50, vol20 < its 252-session median and close > close 20 sessions ago; exit early below SMA50
params.sizing: vt = min(1, 0.35/vol20) on synthetic QLD*, cap 0.98
params.yield_mechanics: accrual on the session's ENDING uninvested cash balance at rate[i-1]/252 (one session's lag, as the financing leg and the archived report arm A_ALL use); credited (and compounded) on the last session of each calendar month; the pending accrual is not NAV until credited. Alpaca's own documentation of the FDIC Bank Sweep: 'Interest accrues daily based on the day's ending swept balance' and it is 'realized (credited) monthly on the last business day of the month', where it 'stays invested within the sweep program to compound into yield'.

yield_tax.Z1: declared in full as menkul sermaye iradi at the progressive tariff, no indexation, no declaration bar, same March/July instalments
yield_tax.Z1x: report-only upper bound: the interest is never taxed
yield_tax.Z2: as Z1 but with the 22,000 x scale(year) TRY declaration bar of GVK 86/1-c against the year's TRY interest: at or below it nothing is declared, above it the whole amount is (the bar is not an exemption)
yield_tax.base: the interest is added to the same year's declared base as the realised capital gain, so it pays the tariff's marginal rate; a capital loss (already floored at zero) cannot offset it (GVK 88)
